one_line: A master stone-carver from the Pallava period working on the monuments of Mamallapuram along the Coromandel Coast.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean and wiry from labor, medium height
appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, warm brown South Indian complexion, slightly sun-lined skin, straight broad nose, thick eyebrows, calm focused eyes with a faint smile suggesting quiet pride
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted at center, gathered into a short, neat low bun at the back; simple narrow white cloth headband tied around the forehead to keep hair and sweat away while carving
appearance.costume: a draped pale cotton tunic reaching just below the hips, with short sleeves and a modest round neck, worn over a ankle-length unstitched dhoti in muted sand-beige wrapped tightly at the waist and pleated in front; a darker brown cotton angavastra (shoulder cloth) hangs from the left shoulder and wraps lightly around the torso, edges slightly worn from use; feet in simple leather sandals suited for rocky ground; minimal jewellery: a thin copper torque around the neck and two plain copper bangles on the right wrist, era-appropriate for a skilled artisan but modest compared to nobility.
appearance.signature: a well-used iron hammer in the right hand and a slender pointed stone chisel in the left, both sized for fine relief work, with a small looped leather tool belt at the waist holding additional chisels.

ref_desc: A mid-30s lean Pallava sculptor with warm brown skin, black hair in a short low bun under a white headband, wearing a pale tunic, sand-beige dhoti, dark brown shoulder cloth and sandals, carrying an iron hammer and stone chisel in a warm brown, beige and off-white palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style model of a mid-30s Pallava sculptor from Mamallapuram: lean build, warm brown South Indian skin, oval face with strong jaw, calm focused eyes and a faint confident smile, thick black hair parted in the center and tied into a short low bun at the back, with a simple narrow white cloth headband around the forehead. He wears a pale off-white cotton tunic that reaches just below the hips with short sleeves and a modest round neck, over an ankle-length sand-beige dhoti wrapped and pleated in front, plus a darker brown cotton angavastra draped from his left shoulder around his torso. Add simple leather sandals, a thin copper neck torque and two plain copper bangles on his right wrist. At his waist include a small leather tool belt with extra chisels. In his hands show his signature tools: a well-used iron hammer in the right hand and a slender pointed stone chisel in the left, ready to carve, with a color scheme dominated by warm brown skin tones, sand beige cloth, pale off-white tunic, dark brown shoulder cloth, and metallic iron tools, all rendered clearly so this costume, hair and tools can be redrawn consistently.
